'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**[[Gaza–Israel conflict]]
***[[May 2023 Gaza–Israel clashes|2023 Gaza–Israel clashes]]
****The [[Israeli Air Force]] begins "Operation Shield and Arrow", launching multiple [[airstrike]]s in the [[Gaza Strip]] and killing three senior [[Islamic Jihad Movement in Palestine|Islamic Jihad Movement]] leaders and at least ten [[civilian]]s, including four children. [https://www.jpost.com/breaking-news/article-742463 (''The Jerusalem Post'')] [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israeli-jets-strike-islamic-jihad-targets-gaza-military-2023-05-08/ (Reuters)]
***Two [[Palestinians]] are killed in an Israeli air attack on a car in [[Khan Yunis]] in the Gaza Strip. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/5/9/palestinians-killed-israeli-air-attack-gaza-car (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Battle of Donbas (2022–present)|Battle of Donbas]]
***[[France|French]] journalist [[Arman Soldin]] is killed by a [[Russia]]n rocket strike in [[Chasiv Yar]], [[Donetsk Oblast]], while working for [[Agence France-Presse]]. [https://www.lemonde.fr/en/international/article/2023/05/09/afp-journalist-killed-by-rocket-fire-in-eastern-ukraine_6026058_4.html (''Le Monde'')]
*[[2023 Djerba shooting]]
**Five people are killed and nine more injured during a [[mass shooting]] at the [[El Ghriba Synagogue]] in [[Djerba]], [[Tunisia]]. The perpetrator is shot dead. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/5/10/four-dead-after-attack-near-synagogue-on-tunisias-djerba-island (Al Jazeera)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Canada–China relations]]
**The [[Government of Canada]] expels Chinese [[diplomat]] Zhao Wei following allegations that Zhao targeted Canadian politician [[Michael Chong]]. [[Government of China|China]] has denied the allegations and stated that the action would undermine bilateral relations. [https://edition.cnn.com/2023/05/08/americas/canada-expels-chinese-diplomat-intl/index.html (CNN)]
**[[China]] expels Canadian diplomat Jennifer Lynn Lalonde in a [[tit-for-tat]] decision following the expulsion of Zhao Wei. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/china-expels-canadian-diplomat-tit-tat-response-99188583 (ABC News)] 
*[[France–Russia relations]]
**[[France]]'s [[National Assembly (France)|National Assembly]] votes unanimously to designate [[Russia]]n paramilitary group [[Wagner Group|PMC Wagner]] as a [[List of designated terrorist groups|terrorist organization]]. [https://www.politico.eu/article/pre-write-french-parliament-designates-wagner-a-terrorist-group/ (Politico)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[First arrest of Imran Khan]], [[2023 Imran Khan arrest protests]]
**Former [[Pakistani Prime Minister]] [[Imran Khan]] is arrested on alleged corruption charges during a court appearance in [[Islamabad]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/5/9/former-pakistan-pm-imran-khan-arrested-outside-islamabad-court (Al Jazeera)]
**Nationwide protests occur in [[Pakistan]] following Imran Khan's arrest, with eight people being killed. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-65541215 (BBC News)]
*''[[E. Jean Carroll vs. Donald J. Trump]]''
**A nine-member [[jury]] in [[United States District Court for the Southern District of New York|Manhattan federal court]] finds former [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] liable for sexually abusing magazine writer [[E. Jean Carroll]] in the 1990s, and also finds him liable for [[defamation|defaming]] her. Trump is ordered to pay Carroll [[United States dollar|$]]5 million. [https://www.reuters.com/legal/jurors-set-deliberate-civil-rape-case-against-donald-trump-2023-05-09/ (Reuters)]
